result.summary: Reviewed the food delivery app interface and identified two minor to major layout and content issues.

issues.description: The pizza item shows an unrealistic '-100%' discount badge.
issues.suggestion: Check the backend promotion logic to ensure accurate discount rates are displayed.

issues.description: The name 'Trattoria Piccol' is clipped on the right side of the card.
issues.suggestion: Use text truncation with ellipsis or text wrapping to display longer names neatly.
